source.title: Baden - The Abomination
source.name: Baden
source.description: A Rogue who commands phantoms in battle, striking enemies down with various combat techniques.

skills.name: Omen's Grasp

description.raw: Baden and all his phantoms attack a designated enemy in unison, delivering 4 successive strikes and keeping the target stunned throughout. The first 3 strikes each deal 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage. The final strike deals 420% (ATK-based) + 50% (SP-based) true damage to the target and enemies within 1 tile of them. It also drains 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) HP from the target and inflicts an equal amount of max HP reduction. This skill also prevents the target from recovering HP and Energy for 8s. Baden remains invincible while casting this skill. In Auto Battle, this skill prioritizes the weakest enemy.

skills.name: Wraithbrand

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Baden curses enemies in a straight line in front of him, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) true damage. The curse summons a phantom near an afflicted non-boss enemy the first time their HP ratio drops below 50%. For afflicted boss enemies, a phantom is summoned each time they lose HP equal to 600% of Baden's initial ATK. Phantoms use normal attacks and prioritize the enemy whose curse summoned them. They inherit 60% + 5% (SP-based) of Baden's basic stats and remain invincible. Each boss can generate up to 2 phantoms this way. Active. Baden impales his current target, stunning them for 3s and stealing 20% + 2% (SP-based) of their max HP, up to 200% + 20% (SP-based) of his ATK, along with 100 Energy. He then deals 240% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage.

skills.name: Soul Sunder

description.raw: Baden and his phantoms unleash 5 slashes in unison. The first 4 slashes deal a total of 260% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to the current target. The final slash sends out a sword shock, dealing 260% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles and reducing their Vitality by 20 + 2 (SP-based) for 8s. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
